question: For each instance VM state and completed-migration status, list the instance VM state, a migration activity label ('Active' if any completed migrations exist for that VM state and 'Inactive' otherwise), and the number of distinct instance display names represented. Include subtotals for each VM state and a grand total. Only consider instances whose display name has more than one completed migration, and base the result on the completed-migration details and memory statistics from the provided query.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT i.vm_state, i.display_name, m.id AS mig_id, m.memory_total, m.memory_processed
  FROM migrations m
  JOIN instances i ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid
  WHERE m.status = 'completed'
),
qualifying AS (
  SELECT display_name
  FROM base
  GROUP BY display_name
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT b.*
  FROM base b
  JOIN qualifying q ON q.display_name = b.display_name
)
SELECT
  vm_state,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS migration_activity,
  COUNT(DISTINCT display_name) AS distinct_display_names
FROM filtered
GROUP BY vm_state
WITH ROLLUP
ORDER BY vm_state IS NULL, vm_state;

am.avg_metadata_value) AS deviation_from_avg_metadata_value FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN avg_meta AS am), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(migration_metadata_count) - MIN(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_range, VARIANCE(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_variance, STDDEV(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_stddev FROM `instances` AS i JOIN (SELECT m.instance_uuid, m.id AS migration_id, COUNT(ism.id) AS migration_metadata_count FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i2 ON m.instance_uuid = i2.uuid JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i2.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i2.display_name, 'prime') GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.id) AS per_migration_stats ON i.uuid = per_migration_stats.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY metadata_count_range DESC) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.metadata_count_range, inner_cte.metadata_count_variance, inner_cte.metadata_count_stddev, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM `migrations` AS m2 JOIN `instances` AS i3 ON m2.instance_uuid = i3.uuid WHERE i3.display_name = inner_cte.display_name AND m2.deleted = 0 AND NOT m2.status IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error')) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_migrations FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.metadata_count_range DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT q1.DISPLAY_NAME, q1.metadata_value, q1.NETWORK_INFO, q1.window_column, q1.deviation_from_avg_metadata_value, q2.metadata_count_range, q2.metadata_count_variance, q2.metadata_count_stddev, q2.has_active_migrations FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.DISPLAY_NAME = q2.display_name

WITH blaze_host_minmax AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.HOSTNAME AS instance_hostname, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE AS migration_source_compute, m.DEST_COMPUTE AS migration_dest_compute, m.DEST_HOST AS migration_dest_host, m.MIGRATION_TYPE AS migration_type, m.MEMORY_TOTAL AS memory_total, m.MEMORY_PROCESSED AS memory_processed, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER (PARTITION BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY m.INSTANCE_UUID) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `migrations` AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT i.HOST AS instance_host, MAX(inner_cte.window_column) AS max_of_instance_min_memory_remaining FROM inner_cte JOIN `instances` AS i ON i.UUID = inner_cte.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.HOST), ether_dest_compute_details AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, m.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS instance_vcpus, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS migration_memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER (PARTITION BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ORDER BY m.DEST_COMPUTE) AS window_column FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'ether-18') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(DEST_COMPUTE) OVER (ORDER BY DEST_COMPUTE, migration_id, metadata_key) = DEST_COMPUTE THEN NULL ELSE DEST_COMPUTE END AS dest_compute, migration_id, migration_status, SOURCE_COMPUTE, DEST_HOST, INSTANCE_UUID, instance_display_name, instance_vm_state, instance_memory_mb, instance_vcpus, metadata_key, metadata_value, migration_memory_remaining, window_column AS min_migration_memory_remaining_in_dest_compute, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY DEST_COMPUTE) AS total_rows_in_dest_compute FROM inner_cte ORDER BY DEST_COMPUTE, migration_id, metadata_key) SELECT ed.dest_compute, ed.total_rows_in_dest_compute, ed.min_migration_memory_remaining_in_dest_compute, bh.instance_host AS blaze_instance_host, bh.max_of_instance_min_memory_remaining, ROUND(ed.min_migration_memory_remaining_in_dest_compute / NULLIF(bh.max_of_instance_min_memory_remaining, 0), 4) AS min_dest_compute_memory_remaining_to_blaze_max_instance_min_ratio FROM ether_dest_compute_details AS ed CROSS JOIN blaze_host_minmax AS bh ORDER BY ed.dest_compute, ed.migration_id, ed.metadata_key

WITH vm_state_migration_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(m.memory_total))) AS geometric_mean_memory_total FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE m.memory_total > 0 AND c.network_info <> '' GROUP BY i.vm_state ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_total DESC), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_memory_total) AS benchmark_geometric_mean_memory_total FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.vm_state, ic.geometric_mean_memory_total, b.benchmark_geometric_mean_memory_total AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.geometric_mean_memory_total > b.benchmark_geometric_mean_memory_total * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MIGRATION' WHEN ic.geometric_mean_memory_total < b.benchmark_geometric_mean_memory_total * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MIGRATION' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MIGRATION' END AS migration_category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b ORDER BY ic.geometric_mean_memory_total DESC), confirmed_ether60_migrations AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID AS instance_uuid, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE AS source_compute, m.DEST_COMPUTE AS dest_compute, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'confirmed' AND m.SOURCE_COMPUTE = 'ether-60') SELECT inner_cte.migration_id, inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.source_compute, inner_cte.dest_compute, inner_cte.instance_display_name, inner_cte.instance_vm_state, inner_cte.instance_memory_mb, inner_cte.window_column, i.project_id AS project_id, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM `migrations` AS m2 JOIN `instances` AS i2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid WHERE i2.project_id = i.project_id AND m2.deleted = 0 AND NOT m2.status IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error') AND m2.id <> inner_cte.migration_id) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS project_has_other_active_migrations FROM inner_cte JOIN `instances` AS i ON inner_cte.instance_uuid = i.uuid ORDER BY inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.migration_id) SELECT cem.migration_id, cem.instance_uuid, cem.migration_status, cem.source_compute, cem.dest_compute, cem.instance_display_name, cem.instance_vm_state, cem.instance_memory_mb, cem.window_column, cem.project_id, cem.project_has_other_active_migrations, vms.geometric_mean_memory_total AS vm_state_geometric_mean_memory_total, vms.benchmark AS vm_state_benchmark_geometric_mean_memory_total, vms.migration_category AS vm_state_migration_category FROM confirmed_ether60_migrations AS cem LEFT JOIN vm_state_migration_stats AS vms ON cem.instance_vm_state = vms.vm_state ORDER BY cem.migration_status, cem.migration_id

WITH CompletedMigrationsOnBlaze AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.MIGRATION_TYPE, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, m.MEMORY_TOTAL, MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) OVER (PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE) AS window_column FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), MemoryStatsByDisplayNameOnBlaze AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' AND ism.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), CombinedResults AS (SELECT cm.migration_id, cm.INSTANCE_UUID, cm.MIGRATION_TYPE, cm.SOURCE_COMPUTE, cm.DEST_COMPUTE, cm.DEST_HOST, cm.DISPLAY_NAME, cm.VM_STATE, cm.MEMORY_MB, cm.VCPUS, cm.instance_extra_id, cm.MEMORY_TOTAL, cm.window_column, ms.memory_mb_variance, ms.memory_mb_stddev FROM CompletedMigrationsOnBlaze AS cm LEFT JOIN MemoryStatsByDisplayNameOnBlaze AS ms ON ms.DISPLAY_NAME = cm.DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY migration_id, DISPLAY_NAME

historical_programs.sql_template: WITH q1 AS (SELECT m.status AS migration_status, i.vm_state AS instance_vm_state, COUNT(m.id) AS migration_count, MIN(i.memory_mb) AS min_instance_memory_mb FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY m.status, i.vm_state), q2 AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, m.STATUS AS migration_status, COUNT(i.ID) AS instance_count, MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS min_memory_total FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `migrations` AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.HIDDEN = 0 GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, m.STATUS) SELECT q1.migration_status, q1.instance_vm_state, q1.migration_count, q1.min_instance_memory_mb, q2.instance_count, q2.min_memory_total FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.migration_status = q2.migration_status AND q1.instance_vm_state = q2.vm_state ORDER BY q1.migration_count DESC

WITH HostCompletedMigrations AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.MIGRATION_TYPE, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, m.MEMORY_TOTAL, MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) OVER (PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE) AS window_column FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), FlareCompletedMigrations AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, ie.FLAVOR, AVG(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.DISPLAY_NAME, 'flare') ORDER BY m.ID) SELECT hcm.MIGRATION_TYPE, COUNT(DISTINCT hcm.migration_id) AS Completed_Migration_Count, ROUND(AVG(hcm.MEMORY_MB), 0) AS Avg_Instance_Memory_MB, ROUND(AVG(hcm.VCPUS), 2) AS Avg_Instance_VCPUs, ROUND(AVG(hcm.window_column), 2) AS Avg_Min_MemoryTotal_By_Type, ROUND(AVG(fcm.window_column), 2) AS Avg_Running_Avg_MigrationId_For_Flare FROM HostCompletedMigrations AS hcm LEFT JOIN FlareCompletedMigrations AS fcm ON hcm.INSTANCE_UUID = fcm.INSTANCE_UUID AND hcm.migration_id = fcm.migration_id WHERE REGEXP_LIKE(hcm.DISPLAY_NAME, 'flare') GROUP BY hcm.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY Completed_Migration_Count DESC

WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.ID AS instance_id, i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.USER_ID, i.PROJECT_ID, i.HOSTNAME, i.VM_STATE, i.POWER_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, c.ID AS info_cache_id, c.NETWORK_INFO, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.PROJECT_ID ORDER BY i.PROJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), ZoneAverages AS (SELECT i2.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, AVG(i2.MEMORY_MB * 1.0) AS avg_zone_memory_mb FROM `instances` AS i2 WHERE i2.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' za.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = inner_cte.AVAILABILITY_ZONE WHERE inner_cte.MEMORY_MB > za.avg_zone_memory_mb), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_instance_memory_mb, SUM(m.MEMORY_PROCESSED) AS total_migration_memory_processed FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded') SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, inner_cte.min_instance_memory_mb, inner_cte.total_migration_memory_processed, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM `migrations` AS m2 JOIN `instances` AS i2 ON m2.INSTANCE_UUID = i2.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS ic2 ON i2.UUID = ic2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m2.STATUS = 'completed' AND i2.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' AND ic2.DELETED = 0) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_network_info_cache FROM inner_cte JOIN `instances` AS i ON i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, inner_cte.min_instance_memory_mb, inner_cte.total_migration_memory_processed) SELECT q1.instance_id, q1.instance_uuid, q1.user_id, q1.project_id, q1.hostname, q1.vm_state, q1.power_state, q1.memory_mb, q1.vcpus, q1.availability_zone, q1.info_cache_id, q1.network_info, q1.window_column AS min_memory_mb_within_project, q2.min_instance_memory_mb AS shelved_offloaded_min_instance_memory_mb, q2.total_migration_memory_processed, q2.has_network_info_cache FROM q1 LEFT JOIN q2 ON q2.vm_state = q1.vm_state WHERE q1.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' ORDER WITH base AS (
  SELECT i.vm_state, i.display_name, m.id AS mig_id, m.memory_total, m.memory_processed
  FROM migrations m
  JOIN instances i ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid
  WHERE m.status = 'completed'
),
qualifying AS (
  SELECT display_name
  FROM base
  GROUP BY display_name
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT b.*
  FROM base b
  JOIN qualifying q ON q.display_name = b.display_name
)
SELECT
  vm_state,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS migration_activity,
  COUNT(DISTINCT display_name) AS distinct_display_names
FROM filtered
GROUP BY vm_state
WITH ROLLUP
ORDER BY vm_state IS NULL, vm_state;
